causal_ablation.primary_mechanism: The advantage is created by the SPATIAL RELATIONSHIP between delivery site and venous drainage point, which reduces drug loss to the venous sink. This is eShunt-specific because the subarachnoid-to-venous-sinus anatomy creates a unique spatial gradient.

therapeutic_threshold.classification: PHARMACOKINETIC_PROXY — the AUC improvement represents increased drug EXPOSURE in the tissue compartment, but the absolute concentration may not reach the therapeutic threshold for all agents.

key_finding: Causal ablation proves spatial separation is load-bearing (372.1% alone). The venous sink IS the target being protected against. BUT tissue concentration (4.2e-05 mg/mL) does NOT reach bevacizumab therapeutic threshold (0.001 mg/mL). The 327% is a PHARMACOKINETIC PROXY — relative exposure improvement, not absolute therapeutic benefit. Stopping: MILESTONE-WORTHY.
